Submission Instructions

  1. Exchange your raw diplomatic transcription (transcription_A.txt) with your assigned workshop partner (transcription_B.txt).
  2. Perform a character-level and word-level diff between both files in VS Code or Terminal (diff -u transcription_A.txt transcription_B.txt).
  3. Generate a reconciliation report listing every discrepancy, citing line numbers and specific glyph differences.
  4. Examine the high-resolution facsimile together to adjudicate each discrepancy, deciding whether A is correct, B is correct, or a third reading is warranted.
  5. Submit your final consensus_ground_truth.txt file and a 300–500 word reflection analyzing which categories of palaeographical features (e.g. abbreviations, ink erosion, ligatures) generated the highest discrepancy rates.
